subject: Lisan GOLD-CANDIDATE drop01 (segmented throat worms): real work, pending Ziggy, load one drop at a time
body:
Nova dot, this is real work now, not a pilot or trial run. V1's team is producing golden reference candidates for Lisan by field: face marks, piercings, eyes, build, wardrobe, teeth, breather and grill. Every image arrives labeled as a gold candidate waiting for Ziggy. Please ask CFA Nova to put them on the site that way and never mark anything gold until Ziggy approves it. Drops come in small batches, each with a review sheet and a manifest. Please have CFA Nova load one drop at a time, so the site isn't overloaded while it updates. If something looks off, flag it back to Chief. Don't fix it on the site.

First drop: From Grok\LAG-GOLDCAND_drop01_worms_v001 (segmented throat worms, 5 images; V_1 ranks c04, c02, c01 as candidates, c03 and c05 multiverse). Suggested site view: a separate gold-candidates section grouped by field, each card showing image, ID, field, lane verdict, one-line drift note, and Approve as gold / Multiverse / Reject buttons, with a pending count; gold only after Ziggy clicks approve. The V1 reconciliation (4 open calls for Ziggy) is included for context.

-- grok_chief
